# CHALES Hair Boutique

> Hair salon in Oakdale, Bellville, Cape Town, South Africa, run by stylist Chanté since 2025. Known for hair colour, highlights and balayage, and smoothing treatments: Nanoplastia, keratin, Brazilian blowout and hair botox. Bookings through Lexi, the salon's WhatsApp assistant, on 071 429 6057.

## Key facts

- Address: 46 Alexandra Street (inside the Vodacom building), Oakdale, Bellville, Cape Town, 7530, South Africa
- Hours: Tuesday to Friday 08:00 to 16:30, Saturday 09:00 to 15:00, closed Sunday and Monday
- Book: WhatsApp Lexi on +27 71 429 6057 (https://wa.me/27714296057)
- Call Chanté: +27 81 433 2756
- Email: info@chaleshairboutique.co.za
- Payment: cash, card and EFT. Prices in South African rand (ZAR)
- Nearby areas served: Bellville, Oakdale, Parow, Goodwood, Durbanville, Cape Town northern suburbs
- Products used: Cadiveu Brasil Cacau, Koffeetox, Kallos Professional
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chaleshairboutique
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@chales418
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/chaleshairboutique
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=13659620552899745009

## Prices (November 2026)

- Wash and blow dry: R250 to R350
- Precision cut: R350. Cut and blow dry: R450. Trim: R200
- Root touch-up: R450. Full colour: R650 to R850
- Highlights: R650 half head, R950 full head. Balayage: from R1 200
- Hair botox: R1 200 to R1 500. Glowtox: R1 400
- Keratin or Brazilian blowout: R1 500 to R1 800
- Nanoplastia (formaldehyde-free smoothing): R1 800 to R2 200
